name: Potato Gnocchi in Brown Butter & Parmesan
whyItWorks: Shelf-stable or refrigerated potato gnocchi are pillows of mashed peeled potato and white flour that boil in 180 seconds and require almost zero chewing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil gnocchi until they float, then toss in a skillet with melted butter, a splash of pasta water, garlic powder, and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano (~0g lactose).
